title: The held page that hosts the docks

aliases.name: The held page that hosts three video docks

members.role: the ledger page mounts on the cream and is never cut away - the whole argument is told against it
the first moving card pops at its reading box, holds, then parks beside the chart
the callout names what the parked face is saying, on the page underneath
the second moving card replaces the first in the same box while the page stands
the light lands on the page's own datum while the card is still parked
the second callout names the lit number - a build inside the held frame, not a cut
a third moving card lands late in the same composition, still with no cut

does: One chart page is mounted and held for 37 s while other people's faces arrive, park and leave on it and the page's own numbers are lit and named - six builds, no cut, so the window is the composition.
